sanskrit: rathāś ca bahavo bhagnā hayāś ca śataśo hatāḥ gajāś ca sagajārohāḥ petur urvyāṃ mahāmṛdhe
english: Many chariots were shattered and horses slain by the hundred, and elephants together with their riders fell upon the earth in that great battle.

sanskrit: rathinaḥ sādinaś caiva tatra tatra nisūditāḥ dṛśyante bahudhā rājan veṣṭamānāḥ samantataḥ
english: Charioteers and horsemen, struck down here and there, O king, were seen on every side writhing in their numbers.

sanskrit: hatair gajapadātyoghair vājibhiś ca nisūditaiḥ rathaiś ca bahudhā bhagnaiḥ samāstīryata medinī
english: With slaughtered hosts of elephants and foot-soldiers, with horses cut down, and with chariots broken in their multitudes, the earth was overspread.

sanskrit: chatraiś ca bahudhā chinnair dhvajaiś ca vinipātitaiḥ aṅkuśair apaviddhaiś ca paristomaiś ca bhārata
english: With parasols hacked to pieces and banners cast down, with goads flung away and with horse-cloths, O Bhārata,

sanskrit: keyūrair aṅgadair hārai rāṅkavair mṛditais tathā uṣṇīṣair apaviddhaiś ca cāmaravyajanair api
english: with armlets, bracelets, and necklaces, with trampled deerskin coverlets, with turbans flung away, and with yak-tail fans as well,

sanskrit: tatra tatrāpaviddhaiś ca bāhubhiś candanokṣitaiḥ ūrubhiś ca narendrāṇāṃ samāstīryata medinī
english: and here and there with the sandal-anointed arms and thighs of kings strewn about, the earth was overspread.

sanskrit: tatrādbhutam apaśyāma raṇe pārthasya vikramam śaraiḥ saṃvārya tān vīrān nijaghāna balaṃ tava
english: There we beheld the wondrous prowess of Pārtha in battle: checking those heroes with his arrows, he struck down your host.

sanskrit: putras tu tava taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhīmārjunasamāgamam gāṅgeyasya rathābhyāśam upajagme mahābhaye
english: But your son, beholding that onset of Bhīma and Arjuna, drew near to the chariot of the son of Gaṅgā in that great peril.

sanskrit: kṛpaś ca kṛtavarmā ca saindhavaś ca jayadrathaḥ vindānuvindāv āvantyāv ājagmuḥ saṃyugaṃ tadā
english: And Kṛpa and Kṛtavarman, and Jayadratha lord of the Sindhus, and the two Avantis Vinda and Anuvinda then came to the fray.

sanskrit: tato bhīmo maheṣvāsaḥ phalgunaś ca mahārathaḥ kauravāṇāṃ camūṃ ghorāṃ bhṛśaṃ dudruvatū raṇe
english: Then Bhīma the mighty archer and Phalguna the great chariot-warrior charged furiously against the dread host of the Kauravas in battle.

sanskrit: tato barhiṇavājānām ayutāny arbudāni ca dhanaṃjayarathe tūrṇaṃ pātayanti sma saṃyuge
english: Then tens of thousands and millions of peacock-feathered arrows they swiftly let fall upon the chariot of Dhanaṃjaya in the encounter.

sanskrit: tatas tāñ śarajālena saṃnivārya mahārathān pārthaḥ samantāt samare preṣayām āsa mṛtyave
english: Then Pārtha, warding off those great chariot-warriors with a net of arrows, dispatched them on every side in battle to their death.

sanskrit: śalyas tu samare jiṣṇuṃ krīḍann iva mahārathaḥ ājaghānorasi kruddho bhallaiḥ saṃnataparvabhiḥ
english: But Śalya, that great chariot-warrior, as though in sport, in his wrath struck Jiṣṇu upon the chest with smooth-jointed broad-headed shafts.

sanskrit: tasya pārtho dhanuś chittvā hastāvāpaṃ ca pañcabhiḥ athainaṃ sāyakais tīkṣṇair bhṛśaṃ vivyādha marmaṇi
english: Pārtha, cutting through his bow and his leather guard with five arrows, then pierced him sorely in the vitals with keen shafts.

sanskrit: athānyad dhanur ādāya samare bhārasādhanam madreśvaro raṇe jiṣṇuṃ tāḍayām āsa roṣitaḥ
english: Then the lord of the Madras, taking up another bow able to bear the strain, enraged, smote Jiṣṇu in battle.

sanskrit: tribhiḥ śarair mahārāja vāsudevaṃ ca pañcabhiḥ bhīmasenaṃ ca navabhir bāhvor urasi cārpayat
english: With three arrows, O great king, he struck Vāsudeva, with five, and Bhīmasena with nine, planting them in their arms and chests.

sanskrit: tato droṇo mahārāja māgadhaś ca mahārathaḥ duryodhanasamādiṣṭau taṃ deśam upajagmatuḥ
english: Then Droṇa, O great king, and the Māgadha, that great chariot-warrior, at Duryodhana's command, drew near to that place,

sanskrit: yatra pārtho mahārāja bhīmasenaś ca pāṇḍavaḥ kauravyasya mahāsenāṃ jaghnatus tau mahārathau
english: where Pārtha, O great king, and Bhīmasena the Pāṇḍava, those two great chariot-warriors, were slaying the mighty host of Kaurava.

sanskrit: jayatsenas tu samare bhīmaṃ bhīmāyudhaṃ yuvā vivyādha niśitair bāṇair aṣṭabhir bharatarṣabha
english: But young Jayatsena in battle pierced Bhīma of dreadful weapons with eight whetted arrows, O bull of the Bhāratas.

sanskrit: taṃ bhīmo daśabhir viddhvā punar vivyādha saptabhiḥ sārathiṃ cāsya bhallena rathanīḍād apāharat
english: Bhīma, piercing him with ten arrows, struck him again with seven, and with a broad-headed shaft swept his charioteer from the chariot-seat.

sanskrit: udbhrāntais turagaiḥ so 'tha dravamāṇaiḥ samantataḥ māgadho 'pahṛto rājā sarvasainyasya paśyataḥ
english: Then by his frenzied horses, racing off in every direction, the Māgadha king was carried away while the whole army looked on.

sanskrit: droṇas tu vivaraṃ labdhvā bhīmasenaṃ śilīmukhaiḥ vivyādha bāṇaiḥ suśitaiḥ pañcaṣaṣṭyā tam āyasaiḥ
english: But Droṇa, finding an opening, pierced Bhīmasena with sixty-five sharp-honed iron shafts.

sanskrit: taṃ bhīmaḥ samaraślāghī guruṃ pitṛsamaṃ raṇe vivyādha navabhir bhallais tathā ṣaṣṭyā ca bhārata
english: Bhīma, glorious in battle, pierced that teacher, who was as a father to him, with nine broad-headed shafts and then with sixty, O Bhārata.

sanskrit: arjunas tu suśarmāṇaṃ viddhvā bahubhir āyasaiḥ vyadhamat tasya tat sainyaṃ mahābhrāṇi yathānilaḥ
english: But Arjuna, piercing Suśarman with many iron shafts, scattered his army as the wind scatters great clouds.

sanskrit: tato bhīṣmaś ca rājā ca saubalaś ca bṛhadbalaḥ abhyadravanta saṃkruddhā bhīmasenadhanaṃjayau
english: Then Bhīṣma and the king, and the son of Subala, and Bṛhadbala, full of wrath, rushed upon Bhīmasena and Dhanaṃjaya.

sanskrit: tathaiva pāṇḍavāḥ śūrā dhṛṣṭadyumnaś ca pārṣataḥ abhyadravan raṇe bhīṣmaṃ vyāditāsyam ivāntakam
english: So too the valiant Pāṇḍavas and Dhṛṣṭadyumna the son of Pṛṣata rushed in battle upon Bhīṣma, who was like Death with jaws agape.

sanskrit: śikhaṇḍī tu samāsādya bhāratānāṃ pitāmaham abhyadravata saṃhṛṣṭo bhayaṃ tyaktvā yatavratam
english: And Śikhaṇḍin, drawing near to the grandsire of the Bhāratas, charged him exultantly, casting off all fear, against that man of steadfast vows.

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhiramukhāḥ pārthāḥ puraskṛtya śikhaṇḍinam ayodhayan raṇe bhīṣmaṃ saṃhatāḥ saha sṛñjayaiḥ
english: The sons of Pṛthā, led by Yudhiṣṭhira, placing Śikhaṇḍin at their head, fought Bhīṣma in battle, united together with the Sṛñjayas.

sanskrit: tathaiva tāvakāḥ sarve puraskṛtya yatavratam śikhaṇḍipramukhān pārthān yodhayanti sma saṃyuge
english: In like manner all your men, placing the man of steadfast vows at their head, fought the sons of Pṛthā led by Śikhaṇḍin in the encounter.

sanskrit: tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ kauravāṇāṃ bhayāvaham tatra pāṇḍusutaiḥ sārdhaṃ bhīṣmasya vijayaṃ prati
english: Then there arose a battle fearful to the Kauravas, between Bhīṣma and the sons of Pāṇḍu, contending for the victory.

sanskrit: tāvakānāṃ raṇe bhīṣmo glaha āsīd viśāṃ pate tatra hi dyūtam āyātaṃ vijayāyetarāya vā
english: In that battle Bhīṣma was the stake of your men, O lord of peoples; for there the game of dice had come round, for victory or for the contrary.

sanskrit: dhṛṣṭadyumno mahārāja sarvasainyāny acodayat abhidravata gāṅgeyaṃ mā bhaiṣṭa narasattamāḥ
english: Dhṛṣṭadyumna, O great king, urged on all the troops: 'Charge upon the son of Gaṅgā! Fear not, O best of men!'

sanskrit: senāpativacaḥ śrutvā pāṇḍavānāṃ varūthinī bhīṣmam evābhyayāt tūrṇaṃ prāṇāṃs tyaktvā mahāhave
english: Hearing the words of their commander, the host of the Pāṇḍavas, casting aside their very lives in that great battle, swiftly advanced upon Bhīṣma alone.

sanskrit: bhīṣmo 'pi rathināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ pratijagrāha tāṃ camūm āpatantīṃ mahārāja velām iva mahodadhiḥ
english: And Bhīṣma, foremost of chariot-warriors, received that onrushing host, O great king, as the great ocean receives its shore.

sanskrit: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca kathaṃ śāṃtanavo bhīṣmo daśame 'hani saṃjaya ayudhyata mahāvīryaiḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ sahasṛñjayaiḥ
english: Dhṛtarāṣṭra said: How, O Saṃjaya, did Bhīṣma the son of Śaṃtanu fight on the tenth day against the mighty Pāṇḍavas together with the Sṛñjayas?

sanskrit: kuravaś ca kathaṃ yuddhe pāṇḍavān pratyavārayan ācakṣva me mahāyuddhaṃ bhīṣmasyāhavaśobhinaḥ
english: And how did the Kurus in the fighting hold back the Pāṇḍavas? Tell me of the great battle of Bhīṣma, resplendent in war.

sanskrit: saṃjaya uvāca kuravaḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ sārdhaṃ yathāyudhyanta bhārata yathā ca tad abhūd yuddhaṃ tat te vakṣyāmi śṛṇvataḥ
english: Saṃjaya said: How the Kurus fought together with the Pāṇḍavas, O Bhārata, and how that battle came to pass, I shall tell you as you listen.

sanskrit: preṣitāḥ paralokāya paramāstraiḥ kirīṭinā ahany ahani saṃprāptās tāvakānāṃ rathavrajāḥ
english: Day after day the bands of chariots of your men, dispatched to the other world by the Diademed One with his supreme weapons, met their end.

sanskrit: yathāpratijñaṃ kauravyaḥ sa cāpi samitiṃjayaḥ pārthānām akarod bhīṣmaḥ satataṃ samitikṣayam
english: And the Kaurava Bhīṣma, victorious in assemblies of war, true to his vow, wrought continual havoc among the hosts of the sons of Pṛthā.

sanskrit: kurubhiḥ sahitaṃ bhīṣmaṃ yudhyamānaṃ mahāratham arjunaṃ ca sapāñcālyaṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃśayitā janāḥ
english: Beholding Bhīṣma, that great chariot-warrior, fighting joined with the Kurus, and Arjuna with the Pāñcālas, men were filled with doubt as to the outcome.

sanskrit: daśame 'hani tasmiṃs tu bhīṣmārjunasamāgame avartata mahāraudraḥ satataṃ samitikṣayaḥ
english: On that tenth day, in that clash of Bhīṣma and Arjuna, there raged a most terrible and unceasing destruction of the hosts.

sanskrit: tasminn ayutaśo rājan bhūyaś ca sa paraṃtapaḥ bhīṣmaḥ śāṃtanavo yodhāñ jaghāna paramāstravit
english: Therein, O king, Bhīṣma the son of Śaṃtanu, that scorcher of foes, knower of the supreme weapons, slew warriors by the ten thousand and yet more.

sanskrit: yeṣām ajñātakalpāni nāmagotrāṇi pārthiva te hatās tatra bhīṣmeṇa śūrāḥ sarve 'nivartinaḥ
english: Those whose names and lineages were all but unknown, O king—all those heroes who turned not back were there slain by Bhīṣma.

sanskrit: daśāhāni tatas taptvā bhīṣmaḥ pāṇḍavavāhinīm niravidyata dharmātmā jīvitena paraṃtapaḥ
english: Then, having scorched the Pāṇḍava host for ten days, Bhīṣma, righteous of soul, that scorcher of foes, grew weary of his life.

sanskrit: sa kṣipraṃ vadham anvicchann ātmano 'bhimukhaṃ raṇe na hanyāṃ mānavaśreṣṭhān saṃgrāme 'bhimukhān iti
english: Swiftly seeking his own slaughter, face to face in battle, he thought: 'Let me not strike down these best of men who stand before me in the fray.'

sanskrit: cintayitvā mahābāhuḥ pitā devavratas tava abhyāśasthaṃ mahārāja pāṇḍavaṃ vākyam abravīt
english: So having reflected, the mighty-armed Devavrata, your father, O great king, spoke these words to the Pāṇḍava who stood near at hand:

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhira mahāprājña sarvaśāstraviśārada śṛṇu me vacanaṃ tāta dharmyaṃ svargyaṃ ca jalpataḥ
english: 'Yudhiṣṭhira, deeply wise, versed in all the scriptures, hear, my son, the word I speak, righteous and leading to heaven.'

sanskrit: nirviṇṇo 'smi bhṛśaṃ tāta dehenānena bhārata ghnataś ca me gataḥ kālaḥ subahūn prāṇino raṇe
english: 'I am utterly weary, my son, of this body of mine, O Bhārata; and my time has been spent in slaying very many living beings in battle.'

sanskrit: tasmāt pārthaṃ purodhāya pāñcālān sṛñjayāṃs tathā madvadhe kriyatāṃ yatno mama ced icchasi priyam
english: 'Therefore, placing Pārtha at the fore, together with the Pāñcālas and the Sṛñjayas, let effort be made for my slaying, if you would do me a kindness.'

sanskrit: tasya tan matam ājñāya pāṇḍavaḥ satyadarśanaḥ bhīṣmaṃ pratiyayau yattaḥ saṃgrāme saha sṛñjayaiḥ
english: Knowing that intent of his, the Pāṇḍava of truthful vision advanced intently against Bhīṣma in battle, together with the Sṛñjayas.

sanskrit: dhṛṣṭadyumnas tato rājan pāṇḍavaś ca yudhiṣṭhiraḥ śrutvā bhīṣmasya tāṃ vācaṃ codayām āsatur balam
english: Then Dhṛṣṭadyumna, O king, and the Pāṇḍava Yudhiṣṭhira, having heard that speech of Bhīṣma, urged on their host.

sanskrit: abhidravata yudhyadhvaṃ bhīṣmaṃ jayata saṃyuge rakṣitāḥ satyasaṃdhena jiṣṇunā ripujiṣṇunā
english: 'Charge! Fight! Conquer Bhīṣma in the encounter, guarded as you are by the truthful-vowed Jiṣṇu, victor over his foes!'

sanskrit: ayaṃ cāpi maheṣvāsaḥ pārṣato vāhinīpatiḥ bhīmasenaś ca samare pālayiṣyati vo dhruvam
english: 'And this mighty archer too, the son of Pṛṣata, commander of the host, and Bhīmasena in battle, will surely protect you.'

sanskrit: na vai bhīṣmād bhayaṃ kiṃ cit kartavyaṃ yudhi sṛñjayāḥ dhruvaṃ bhīṣmaṃ vijeṣyāmaḥ puraskṛtya śikhaṇḍinam
english: 'No fear at all need be felt of Bhīṣma in the fight, O Sṛñjayas; surely we shall conquer Bhīṣma, placing Śikhaṇḍin at our head.'

sanskrit: tathā tu samayaṃ kṛtvā daśame 'hani pāṇḍavāḥ brahmalokaparā bhūtvā saṃjagmuḥ krodhamūrchitāḥ
english: Having thus made their compact, on the tenth day the Pāṇḍavas, intent on the world of Brahmā, came together swooning with wrath.

sanskrit: śikhaṇḍinaṃ puraskṛtya pāṇḍavaṃ ca dhanaṃjayam bhīṣmasya pātane yatnaṃ paramaṃ te samāsthitāḥ
english: Placing Śikhaṇḍin and the Pāṇḍava Dhanaṃjaya at their head, they set themselves to the utmost effort for the felling of Bhīṣma.

sanskrit: tatas tava sutādiṣṭā nānājanapadeśvarāḥ droṇena sahaputreṇa sahasenā mahābalāḥ
english: Then, at the command of your son, the lords of many lands, mighty in strength, together with their armies, with Droṇa and his son,

sanskrit: duḥśāsanaś ca balavān saha sarvaiḥ sahodaraiḥ bhīṣmaṃ samaramadhyasthaṃ pālayāṃ cakrire tadā
english: and the powerful Duḥśāsana with all his brothers, then guarded Bhīṣma stationed in the midst of the battle.

sanskrit: tatas tu tāvakāḥ śūrāḥ puraskṛtya yatavratam śikhaṇḍipramukhān pārthān yodhayanti sma saṃyuge
english: Then your heroes, placing the man of steadfast vows at their head, fought the sons of Pṛthā led by Śikhaṇḍin in the encounter.

sanskrit: cedibhiś ca sapāñcālaiḥ sahito vānaradhvajaḥ yayau śāṃtanavaṃ bhīṣmaṃ puraskṛtya śikhaṇḍinam
english: And he of the monkey-bannered chariot, joined with the Cedis and the Pāñcālas, advanced against Bhīṣma the son of Śaṃtanu, placing Śikhaṇḍin at the fore.

sanskrit: droṇaputraṃ śiner naptā dhṛṣṭaketus tu pauravam yudhāmanyuḥ sahāmātyaṃ duryodhanam ayodhayat
english: The grandson of Śini fought the son of Droṇa, Dhṛṣṭaketu the Paurava, and Yudhāmanyu fought Duryodhana together with his counsellors.

sanskrit: virāṭas tu sahānīkaḥ sahasenaṃ jayadratham vṛddhakṣatrasya dāyādam āsasāda paraṃtapaḥ
english: And Virāṭa, that scorcher of foes, with his army, closed with Jayadratha, heir of Vṛddhakṣatra, together with his host.

sanskrit: madrarājaṃ maheṣvāsaṃ sahasainyaṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ bhīmasenābhiguptaś ca nāgānīkam upādravat
english: Yudhiṣṭhira, guarded by Bhīmasena, fell upon the mighty archer the king of the Madras with his army, and upon the elephant-division.

sanskrit: apradhṛṣyam anāvāryaṃ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varam droṇaṃ prati yayau yattaḥ pāñcālyaḥ saha somakaiḥ
english: Against Droṇa—unassailable, irresistible, foremost of all bearers of weapons—the prince of Pāñcāla advanced intently together with the Somakas.

sanskrit: karṇikāradhvajaṃ cāpi siṃhaketur ariṃdamaḥ pratyujjagāma saubhadraṃ rājaputro bṛhadbalaḥ
english: And the prince Bṛhadbala, the lion-bannered subduer of foes, advanced to meet the son of Subhadrā, whose banner bore the karṇikāra blossom.

sanskrit: śikhaṇḍinaṃ ca putrās te pāṇḍavaṃ ca dhanaṃjayam rājabhiḥ samare sārdham abhipetur jighāṃsavaḥ
english: And your sons, together with the kings, eager to slay, fell in battle upon Śikhaṇḍin and the Pāṇḍava Dhanaṃjaya.

sanskrit: tasminn atimahābhīme senayor vai parākrame saṃpradhāvatsv anīkeṣu medinī samakampata
english: In that most dreadful clash of valour between the two armies, as the divisions charged headlong, the earth quaked.

sanskrit: tāny anīkāny anīkeṣu samasajjanta bhārata tāvakānāṃ pareṣāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā śāṃtanavaṃ raṇe
english: Those divisions, O Bhārata, clashed division against division, of your men and of the foe, at the sight of the son of Śaṃtanu in battle.

sanskrit: tatas teṣāṃ prayatatām anyonyam abhidhāvatām prādurāsīn mahāñ śabdo dikṣu sarvāsu bhārata
english: Then from those striving warriors rushing upon one another, a great clamour arose in all the quarters, O Bhārata.

sanskrit: śaṅkhadundubhighoṣaiś ca vāraṇānāṃ ca bṛṃhitaiḥ siṃhanādaiś ca sainyānāṃ dāruṇaḥ samapadyata
english: With the blare of conches and kettledrums, with the trumpeting of elephants, and with the lions' roars of the troops, it grew terrible.

sanskrit: sā ca sarvanarendrāṇāṃ candrārkasadṛśī prabhā vīrāṅgadakirīṭeṣu niṣprabhā samapadyata
english: And the splendour of all those kings, like that of the moon and the sun, upon the armlets and diadems of the heroes, grew dimmed.

sanskrit: rajomeghāś ca saṃjajñuḥ śastravidyudbhir āvṛtāḥ dhanuṣāṃ caiva nirghoṣo dāruṇaḥ samapadyata
english: Clouds of dust arose, wreathed about with the lightning of weapons, and the twang of the bows grew terrible.

sanskrit: bāṇaśaṅkhapraṇādāś ca bherīṇāṃ ca mahāsvanāḥ rathagoṣaś ca saṃjagmuḥ senayor ubhayor api
english: The whir of arrows, the blast of conches, the great din of drums, and the rumble of chariots all blended together in both the armies.

sanskrit: prāsaśaktyṛṣṭisaṃghaiś ca bāṇaughaiś ca samākulam niṣprakāśam ivākāśaṃ senayoḥ samapadyata
english: Thronged with masses of darts, spears, and lances, and with floods of arrows, the sky above the two armies grew as if without light.

sanskrit: anyonyaṃ rathinaḥ petur vājinaś ca mahāhave kuñjarāḥ kuñjarāñ jaghnuḥ padātīṃś ca padātayaḥ
english: Charioteers and horsemen fell upon one another in that great battle; elephants slew elephants, and foot-soldiers slew foot-soldiers.

sanskrit: tad āsīt sumahad yuddhaṃ kurūṇāṃ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha bhīṣmahetor naravyāghra śyenayor āmiṣe yathā
english: That was a mighty battle of the Kurus with the Pāṇḍavas for Bhīṣma's sake, O tiger among men, as of two hawks contending for a piece of flesh.

sanskrit: tayoḥ samāgamo ghoro babhūva yudhi bhārata anyonyasya vadhārthāya jigīṣūṇāṃ raṇājire
english: Terrible was the encounter of those two hosts in the fight, O Bhārata, each bent on the slaughter of the other, eager for victory on the field of battle.

sanskrit: saṃjaya uvāca abhimanyur mahārāja tava putram ayodhayat mahatyā senayā yukto bhīṣmahetoḥ parākramī
english: Saṃjaya said: Abhimanyu, O great king, valiant and joined with a great host, fought your son for Bhīṣma's sake.

sanskrit: duryodhano raṇe kārṣṇiṃ navabhir nataparvabhiḥ ājaghāna raṇe kruddhaḥ punaś cainaṃ tribhiḥ śaraiḥ
english: Duryodhana, wrathful in battle, struck the son of Kṛṣṇā's sister with nine smooth-jointed shafts, and then again with three arrows.

sanskrit: tasya śaktiṃ raṇe kārṣṇir mṛtyor ghorām iva svasām preṣayām āsa saṃkruddho duryodhanarathaṃ prati
english: At him the son of Kṛṣṇā's sister, in fury, hurled in battle a lance dreadful as Death's own sister, straight toward Duryodhana's chariot.
